import RNA, random

target = "......((.......((.((.......((.((...............)).........((...............)).)).......)).((.......((...............)).......)).((.......((.((...............)).........((...............)).)).......)).((.......((...............)).......)).((.......((.((...............)).........((...............)).)).......)).((.......((...........((...............)).)).......)).)).......))......"
n = len(target)

def get_pairs(struct):
    stack=[]
    pairs={}
    for i,c in enumerate(struct):
        if c=='(':
            stack.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=stack.pop()
            pairs[j]=i
            pairs[i]=j
    return pairs

pairs = get_pairs(target)

def fold(seq):
    fc = RNA.fold_compound(seq)
    mfe, energy = fc.mfe()
    return mfe, energy

def build_initial(seed=0):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    seq = [None]*n
    # for paired positions, assign GC pairs with variety
    gc_opts = [('G','C'), ('C','G')]
    au_opts = [('A','U'), ('U','A')]
    for i in range(n):
        if seq[i] is not None: continue
        if target[i]=='(':
            j = pairs[i]
            # mostly GC, some AU for variety to avoid excess stability everywhere
            r = rng.random()
            if r < 0.75:
                a,b = rng.choice(gc_opts)
            else:
                a,b = rng.choice(au_opts)
            seq[i]=a
            seq[j]=b
    for i in range(n):
        if seq[i] is None:
            # unpaired - use A mostly, some variety to prevent misfolding
            seq[i] = rng.choice(['A','A','A','C','U'])
    return ''.join(seq)

best = None
best_dist = 999
for seed in range(30):
    s = build_initial(seed)
    mfe, en = fold(s)
    d = RNA.bp_distance(mfe, target)
    if d < best_dist:
        best_dist = d
        best = s
        best_mfe = mfe
    if d==0:
        break

print("best_dist", best_dist)
print(best)
print(best_mfe)
print(target)
